description: This file defines the 'PolicyModified' class, representing an event triggered after a policy has been modified within the system. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON data, accessing the modified policy, and serialization logic.

classes.name: PolicyModified
classes.description: Represents an event indicating that a policy has been modified. Contains references to the policy, revision, timestamp, and headers, along with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyModified instance with specified policy, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a PolicyModified object from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new PolicyModified instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new PolicyModified instance with the specified DittoHeaders.
